Generic OPTION CLAUSE: The Purchaser reserves the right to increase or decrease the quantity to be ordered up to 25 percent of bid quantity at the time of placement of contract. Generic

(ii) Cause physical damage to the user or equipment during the exploitation. (iii) Tap information resident or transient in the equipment/network. (b) The firm will be considered to be in breach of the procurement contract, in case physical damage, loss of information or infringements related to copyright and Intellectual Property Right (IPRs) are caused due to activation of any such malicious code in embedded software. 5. Generic Manufacturer Authorization:Wherever Authorised Distributors/service providers are submitting the bid, Authorisation Form /Certificate with OEM/Original Service Provider details such as name, designation, address, e-mail Id and Phone No. required to be furnished along with the bid 7. OEM IMPORTED PRODUCTS: In case of imported products, OEM or Authorized Seller of OEM should have a registered office in India to provide after sales service support in India. The certificate to this effect should be submitted. 8. Scope of Supply Scope of supply (Bid price to include all cost components) : Only supply of Goods 9. Certificates Bidder's offer is liable to be rejected if they don't upload any of the certificates / documents sought in the Bid document, ATC and Corrigendum if any. 10. Service & Support Dedicated /toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support : BIDDER/OEM must have Dedicated/toll Free Telephone No. for Service Support. 11. Service & Support Escalation Matrix For Service Support : Bidder/OEM must provide Escalation Matrix of Telephone Numbers for Service Support. 12. Warranty Warranty period of the supplied products shall be 1 years from the date of final acceptance of goods or after completion of installation, commissioning & testing of goods (if included in the scope of supply), at consignee location. OEM Warranty certificates must be submitted by Successful Bidder at the time of delivery of Goods. The seller should guarantee the rectification of goods in case of any break down during the guarantee period. Seller should have well established Installation, Commissioning, Training, Troubleshooting and Maintenance Service group in INDIA for attending the after sales service. Details of Service Centres near consignee destinations are to be uploaded along with the bid.

Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses 1. Payment will be made 100% against delivery of stores in full, good and satisf actory condition, after meeting all terms and conditions given in Tender Enquiry as well as AT/Supply Order. 2. Warranty: All should be supplied with 01 year repair/replacement warranty f rom the date of supply/ technical acceptance of equipment whichever is later. 3. Scope of warranty: i) The OEM/supplier shall be responsible for maintenance such as repair/ replac ement of all supplied equipment during warranty period. ii) The OEM/supplier shall have authorized service centre/workshop in Delhi/NC R or nearby states to provide maintenance services of the equipment at short n otice. iii) The OEM/supplier shall have qualified technical experts, who are proficient in repair/maintenance work. The list of qualified technical experts is to be enclose d along with technical qualification and experience. iv) All records of complaints will be maintained properly by the vendor. 4. Technical Evaluation: 4.1. SPG shall conduct a technical evaluation of the items offered by the bidder as part of the bidding process. The technical evaluation of the equipment quote d by the bidder shall be conducted on any convenient date after fifteen (15) day s from the date of bid opening. The exact date, time, venue and trial directives f or the technical evaluation will be communicated to the bidders in due course. 4.2 A one-time additional opportunity of up to seven (7) days may be granted at the discretion of the SPG to present the equipment physically for evaluation. No further opportunity shall be provided beyond this extended period. Failure to pr esent the equipment within the stipulated timeline shall result in disqualification from the technical evaluation process.

4.3 The bidders shall arrange Technical presentation and live demonstration of t he quoted Voice logger during the period of technical evaluation to show that th eir quoted Equipment fully conforms to this bid technical specifications. 4.4. The technical field evaluation of quoted Equipment is mandatory requireme nt of the bid. Hence, the bidders are advised to make all necessary arrangemen t for the readiness of technical presentation and the live demonstration of their quoted Equipment well in advance as they will be required to adhere to the tim e schedule. Failure to demonstrate the quoted Equipment within stipulated time shall be considered as non say participation and will lead to rejection bid. No mo dification of quoted equipment is permitted during technical field evaluation. 5. Fall Clause: The bidder should submit an undertaking (as part of Fall Clause ) that they have not and will not sell the same material/equipment at prices low er than the contract price, during the currency of this contract till delivery of co mplete store as per contract. In case, it supplies or quotes a lower rate to other Government, Public Se ctors or Private Organizations, it would charge the lower rate to SPG also & pay ment shall be released/adjusted accordingly. 6. Delivery Period: Delivery period mentioned in GeM contract will be from th e date of issuance of GeM Contract or issue of import license whichever is later. 7. Custom Clearance: The clearance of imported equipment and accessories s hall be done by the supplier. 8. The CDEC (Custom Duty Exemption Certificate) for imported items will b e at the discretion of SPG, if applicable, as per rule. 9. New Technology/Upgrade: The supplier shall share with the Purchaser any subsequent software/firmware, upgrade free of cost, so as to ensure that the eq uipment provided under this contract is not rendered obsolete. All software up gradation will be provided in CD/DVD (certified by OEM for no malware) as no In ternet connection is allowed. 10. Manuals: All equipment should be provided with user guides, basic & detail ed service manuals with complete circuit diagram and PCB layout as per SPG’s requirement in hard as well as soft copy. 11. Earliest Acceptable Year of Manufacture: Date of manufacture should n ot be older than 04 months from the date of issuance of GeM Contract. 12. Others: 12.1 The Buyer reserves the right to amend, withdraw or cancel the bid or contr act in part or full, at any stage, in accordance with applicable procurement rule s and GeM guidelines. The decision of the buyer in this regard shall be final and binding. The bidder, by participating in this tender, expressly agrees to this con dition. 12.2 If any stage it is discovered that the seller has made any false declaration, misrepresented facts or suppressed material information in the bid, the buyer r eserves the right to cancel the contract, forfeit any payments or securities and t ake further action as per the provision of GeM/GFR. Such action may be taken e ven after award of contract or during execution. 12.3 The buyer reserves the right to assess the final suitability of the goods sup plied. In cases where the seller offers a higher or improved version of the item

meeting or exceeding the specified technical parameters the buyer may at its discretion, accept such upgraded goods at the same price, terms and conditions provided it does not compromise any critical functional requirements and is in t he interest of the project. 12.4 In case of any ambiguity, the provisions of General Financial Rule-2017 an d manual for procurement of Goods-2024 with the latest applicable amendment s shall prevail. 12.5 Representations:-As per latest functionality/updation of GeM portal, rep resentation against bid, if any, will be acceptable within prescribed time limit th rough GeM only. No manual representation will be entertained. .
